USA_annual_relative_exceedance: Contiguous USA, all four study years, native 0.25° populated cells. Each panel uses the same local 2018–2021 Q90 reference; percentage denominators are the complete UTC days in that calendar year (366 in 2024). Shared colour scale; no data clipping or interpolation. This is a retrospective year comparison, not a four-year trend estimate, a physiological heat-risk scale or a network-fault map. Grey denotes no original assigned population support.
USA_state_detail_absolute_heat: California, Texas and New York display enlargements of the same USA 0.25° cell data, 2022–2025. Only cells whose centres fall inside the retained simplified state polygon are coloured; border-cell assignment is approximate. All panels share the USA/China/Australia absolute-threshold colour domain. No new fine-resolution temperature, state-native population allocation, state network observation, state resilience ranking or causal effect is created by zooming. Grey means no displayed supported cell; source-resolution remains roughly tens of kilometres. State examples were selected for geographic contrast before summaries, not by significance.
